random_trials.seed_reuse: Same seed restarts the same base Gaussian sequence across kinds and sigma levels; both methods see the same observation. Do not pool the 480 records as independent trials.

early_reference.eligibility: no pre-fault confirmed non-normal event; first post-fault confirmed pattern matches kind; first correct confirmation before truth-derived reference

settings.preservation: Historical diagnosis, hardware, website, 3D and application files stay unchanged; new evidence is staged separately.
